⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Very Good Stay Experience

I stayed for 4 nights in a deluxe room. The hotel is quite big, with around 50 rooms and sufficient staff available. It’s family-friendly, and kids can stay comfortably. The location is convenient — right on the main road with a metro station nearby.

There’s an in-house restaurant and complimentary 4 small bottles of mineral water provided daily. The room was spacious with neat and clean linen, fresh towels, and daily housekeeping. Hot water was available 24 hours.

Facilities included a wardrobe, Godrej jewelry locker, and fridge inside the room. Toiletries like shampoo, shaving kit, and dental kit were provided every day.

The staff was polite and helpful, and room service was quick.

Only one observation: the food is a little costly, and half portions are not available. It would be great if they could add a simple veg thali option to the menu.

Overall, a very good experience — I would definitely stay here again in the future.
